Harahap is an Indonesian surname that may refer to the following notable people:Abdul Hakim Harahap (1905–1961), Indonesian politician

Burhanuddin Harahap (1917–1987), Indonesian politician and lawyer
Cico Harahap, Malay-Indonesian actor
Hasjrul Harahap (1931–2014), Indonesian politician and government official
Marah Halim Harahap (1921–2015), Indonesian general, politician, and governor
Mulfachri Harahap, Indonesian politician and lawyer
Parada Harahap .
